item.title: Harry Styles Toasts Thom Yorke at 2026 Ivor Novello Awards: ‘I Cannot Overstate How Much His Work Continues to Influence Me’: Full Speech
item.description:
[Energetic music fades out, and the host speaks]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we dive into the world of music and entertainment. Today, we're talking about a special moment at the 2026 Ivor Novello Awards. Harry Styles took the stage to introduce a music legend, Thom Yorke of Radiohead, with a speech that was both heartfelt and hilarious. Let's take a listen.
[Clip of Harry Styles' speech plays]
Host: As you heard, Harry Styles was born the year after Radiohead's debut album, Pablo Honey, was released. He poked fun at the age difference, saying, "Just going to let that sink in." The audience loved it.
But what's really interesting is how much Thom Yorke's music has influenced Harry Styles. He even joked that he lost his virginity to the intro of Radiohead's "Talk Show Host." And in a more serious note, he credited Thom Yorke's work as a major inspiration for his own music, saying that without "Exit Music," there would be no "Watermelon Sugar."
[Clip of Harry Styles' speech continues]
Host: Harry Styles' speech was a testament to the impact of Thom Yorke's music on his own life and career. And as he presented Thom Yorke with a fellowship prize, it was clear that this was a moment of mutual respect and admiration between two music legends.
[Music transitions to a softer tone]
Host: That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one.
[Outro music plays]
